[Bug] Subverse name disappears when width decreases on mobile view.

Hi!

I added a media query to hide subverse name today on mobile devices because default whoaverse theme was displaying subverse name in a rather bad and useless way, especially when logged in. The name was always partially covered by the user bar, so I figured I'll just hide it altogether until default whoaverse theme is able to render everything in a clean and usable way.
